queries: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT r.Name AS media_type_name, r.rate, r.rate - o.average_rate AS amount_above_average FROM media_rates AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.rate > o.average_rate;

assumptions.assumption: A media type's rate is total bytes divided by total milliseconds. Tracks with unknown byte counts cannot contribute to that rate.

alternatives.interpretation: A media type's rate is the arithmetic mean of its individual track rates.
alternatives.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT r.Name AS media_type_name, r.rate, r.rate - o.average_rate AS amount_above_average FROM media_rates AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.rate > o.average_rate;

assumptions.assumption: A media type’s rate is its total known bytes divided by its total duration; tracks with unknown bytes or nonpositive duration cannot contribute a valid rate.

alternatives.interpretation: A media type’s rate is the simple average of its individual tracks’ bytes-per-millisecond rates.
alternatives.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM MediaType AS mt JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds > 0 GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name), average_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM media_rates) SELECT mr.Name AS media_type_name, mr.rate, mr.rate - a.rate AS amount_above_average FROM media_rates AS mr CROSS JOIN average_rate AS a WHERE mr.rate > a.rate;
